claims.sentence: NICE has published a draft guideline on polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS), the condition formerly called polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), for public consultation.
claims.note: Re-check search: PCOS officially renamed PMOS in May 2026 (project page); draft guideline open for consultation.

claims.sentence: The draft was open for feedback from healthcare professionals, patients and the public from 1 July to 11 August 2026.
It adapts the 2023 international guideline on PCOS to UK practice.
NICE says people with PMOS should be offered a yearly check covering symptoms, treatment and long-term health risks, and that diagnosis should happen sooner.
The draft sets out detailed guidance on when to suspect the condition, and says PMOS should not be ruled out after menopause.
